newsitem.title: SPAIN: Swine fever spreads to another county in Catalonia.
newsitem.headline: Swine fever spreads to another county in Catalonia.

text.p: Spain's Catalan province of Lerida confirmed another outbreak of swine fever, and the fever's spread to another county, the regional Department of Agriculture said on Tuesday.
"We had a new positive case in a farm neighbouring Urgell, but which is in another county," an official at the regional Department of Agriculture told Reuters.
"We discovered a positive case of swine fever in a farm with lactating sows, and another in a farm where their piglets had been transferred," he said.
He added that all the pigs in both farms had been killed, together with those of a third farm where other piglets had been transferred.
According to the official, the additional number of pigs killed between Friday and Sunday was 2,700.
He added that two cases had been analysed positively for swine fever.
A local farmer's union expressed worries that the sickness had spread out of the initial five counties and into a sixth one.
The province of Lerida has around five million of pigs, according to the Department of Agriculture.
